evidence_quotes.O: I listened to orchestra, classic rock, and jazz and these phones sound good on everything. Of course they sound best with SACD or vinyl
evidence_quotes.C: I then got out the manual and found out USB 1.0 was default and a procedure had to be followed to configure for USB 2.0
evidence_quotes.E: If you are a true audiophile and truly know what a great headphone should sound like then stay away from the HD 650s.
evidence_quotes.A: Apple has deliberately made the latest iPod incompatible with lots of earlier equipment and this unit unfortunately will not work with it.
evidence_quotes.N: Even with all my whining and complaining Linksys or the others never once sued me or threatened me in any way.
